status.scope_reason: The company processes, manufactures, and sells whole spices, ground spices, and blended masalas under its own brands Pushp and Munimji.
status.evidence: Pushp Brand (India) Limited received SEBI approval in August 2026 to launch its initial public offering (IPO), operating as an Indore-headquartered manufacturer of pure and blended spices.

claims.claim: The company operates automated manufacturing facilities in Indore with an installed annual capacity of 60,000 metric tonnes, supported by integrated cold storage and warehousing. The Times of India
claims.source: The Times of India

claims.claim: The company has planned a greenfield expansion that includes establishing an integrated storage facility by 2028 to strengthen its supply infrastructure. The Times of India
claims.source: The Times of India

claims.claim: The company reports offering varied package sizing configurations for its spice products, ranging from 1g single-use sachets up to 20kg industrial/commercial packs, according to its official product brochure.
claims.corrected: The company reports offering varied package sizing configurations for its spice products, ranging from 5g (or ₹5 pack sizes) up to 20kg industrial/commercial packs, according to its official product brochure.
claims.source: Pushp Brand Official Product Brochure

claims.claim: The company operates two manufacturing facilities in Indore, Madhya Pradesh—the Bardari facility and the Bharosala facility—with a combined installed capacity of 60,000 MT per annum as of March 31, 2026, according to the Pushp Brand (India) Limited Draft Red Herring Prospectus.
claims.corrected: The company operates two manufacturing facilities in Indore, Madhya Pradesh—the Bardari facility and the Bharosala facility—with a combined installed capacity of 63,000 MT per annum as of March 31, 2026, according to the Pushp Brand (India) Limited Draft Red Herring Prospectus.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited Draft Red Herring Prospectus

claims.claim: The company's manufacturing plants in Indore are fully automated and ISO-certified, as documented in the IndiaIPO Pushp Brand (India) IPO Review.
claims.source: IndiaIPO Pushp Brand (India) IPO Review

claims.claim: The company reports an expansive infrastructure spread over 2,15,000 square feet with a production capacity of 200 metric tonnes per day, as stated on the official Pushp Online Corporate Website.
claims.source: Official Pushp Online Corporate Website About Us page

claims.claim: The company recorded a capacity utilization rate of 38.95% at its Indore facilities during Fiscal 2026, as verified by the InvestorZone DRHP Analysis.
claims.corrected: The company recorded a capacity utilization rate of 37.19% at its Indore facilities during Fiscal 2026, as verified by the InvestorZone DRHP Analysis.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited MainBoard DRHP Details

claims.claim: The company reports utilizing automated process controls, batch traceability systems, and in-house testing laboratories to support its quality control framework across its ISO 9001 and ISO 22000 certified manufacturing plants, according to its Draft Red Herring Prospectus filed in May 2026.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) dated May 26, 2026

claims.claim: The company launched a new product category with "Pushp Masala Chai," a premium tea product range blended with a combination of ten natural spices, as announced in its corporate promotional updates in September 2026.
claims.source: Official Pushp Masale social media and promotional campaign updates (September 2026)

claims.claim: The company launched its "Quick Fry" range, a newly developed collection of complete ready-to-cook mix masalas engineered to reduce meal preparation time, as reported in its official product launch campaigns.
claims.source: Pushp Online official e-commerce store product specifications

claims.claim: The company launched "Pushp Spice Booster," a signature multipurpose masala blend packaged in single-use sachets under its newly introduced Western Spices category, as documented on its retail platform in August 2026.
claims.source: https://pushponline.com

claims.claim: The company operates automated manufacturing facilities in Indore, India, consisting of the Bardari and Bharosala facilities with an aggregate installed capacity of 60,000 metric tonnes per annum as of FY26, according to a draft red herring prospectus review by InvestorZone.
claims.source: https://www.icicisecurities.com/console/uploads/actual/PROJECT-VASUNDHARA---DRHP-(FILING)_1779805606_77.pdf

claims.claim: The company is undertaking a greenfield expansion project that includes an integrated storage facility targeted for commissioning by 2028 and additional grinding and milling capacity by 2029, according to draft papers filed with Sebi.
claims.source: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/indore/indore-based-pushp-brand-files-ipo-papers-with-sebi/articleshow/131398059.cms

claims.claim: The company operates an expansive 2,15,000 square-foot production plant with a capacity of 200 metric tonnes per day that integrates traditional pounding methods with advanced storage and processing technologies, as reported on the official company portal Pushp Online.
claims.source: https://pushponline.com

claims.claim: According to the company's Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated May 26, 2026, the company plans to establish new grinding and milling lines for pure spices, which are expected to become operational in Fiscal 2029.
claims.source: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/indore/indore-based-pushp-brand-files-ipo-papers-with-sebi/articleshow/131398059.cms

claims.claim: Pushp Brand (India) Limited recorded an annual operating revenue of ₹482 crore in FY26, according to its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) submitted to the Securities and Exchange Board of India.
claims.source: SEBI DRHP Prospectus / IPO Platform (https://www.ipoplatform.com/Funding-news/pushp-brand-india-limited)

claims.claim: Pushp Brand (India) Limited achieved a 19% year-on-year growth in operating revenue for FY26, as documented in its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) submitted to the Securities and Exchange Board of India.
claims.source: Equity Research India (https://www.equityresearchindia.com/post/pushp-brand-ipo-dhrp-analysis)

claims.claim: Pushp Brand (India) Limited registered a pure spices product segment revenue of ₹306.30 crore for FY26, as detailed in its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) Analysis.
claims.source: InvestorZone DRHP Analysis (https://investorzone.in/blog/pushp-brand-drhp-a-spice-story-from-indore-with-margins-doing-the-talks)

claims.claim: Pushp Brand (India) Limited reported a 28% year-on-year growth in profit after tax for FY26, according to its Draft Red Herring Prospectus.
claims.source: Entrackr / IPO Watch (https://entrackr.com/news/a91-partners-backed-spice-maker-pushp-files-drhp-for-ofs-only-ipo-11878822)

claims.claim: The company reports a dual-brand strategy with its "Pushp" brand targeting premium and value-added products, and its "Munimji" brand catering to price-sensitive consumer segments according to its draft red herring prospectus.
claims.source: InvestorZone DRHP Analysis (https://investorzone.in/blog/pushp-brand-drhp-a-spice-story-from-indore-with-margins-doing-the-talks)

claims.claim: According to the company's regulatory filings with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, the company commands a 20.7% value market share in the branded spices ecosystem within the state of Madhya Pradesh as of Fiscal 2025.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited SEBI DRHP (Page 2, 9), Business Standard, EquityPandit

claims.claim: The company reports its retail reach extended across 24 states and Union Territories through a network of 1,016 distributors and over 3.68 lakh retail touchpoints as of Fiscal 2026.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited SEBI DRHP, Business Standard, Kotak Neo

claims.claim: According to regulatory documents filed with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, the company holds a dominant market share of approximately 58% within the specialized packaged hing segment in Madhya Pradesh.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited SEBI DRHP, EquityPandit, Business Today

claims.claim: The company reports a diversified product portfolio of packaged spices, blended spices, hinge, and foods offering 312 SKUs as of FY26.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited SEBI DRHP, Upstox, Business Standard

claims.claim: The company reports that its distribution network includes 1,016 distributors and covers over 368,000 retail touchpoints across India as detailed in its Chittorgarh IPO Profile.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited SEBI DRHP via Chittorgarh IPO Profile, Chittorgarh

claims.claim: The company reports that its geographical footprint spans across 24 states and union territories in India, holding a 20.7% market share in packaged spices in Madhya Pradesh as documented in its Chittorgarh IPO Profile.
claims.source: Chittorgarh IPO Profile for Pushp Brand (India) Limited and TKC Report / DRHP filings confirming a 24 state/UT footprint and 20.7% market share in packaged spices in Madhya Pradesh.

claims.claim: The company operates its own dedicated consumer e-commerce portal under the brand Pushp Online to supply its full catalog of pure and blended spices directly to household customers.
claims.source: Official brand communications and pushponline.com website matching the brand's dedicated direct-to-consumer e-commerce portal description.

claims.claim: The company presented its bulk spice solutions and actively targeted commercial chefs, banquet operators, and catering professionals at Stall No. 601 during the FAIC CaterCon Expo & Convention held in Jaipur in August 2026.
claims.source: Federation of All India Caterers (FAIC) CaterCon Convention & Expo 2026 official promotional materials highlighting Pushp Brand at Stall No. 601 in Jaipur.

claims.claim: The company manufactures and markets its "Spice Booster Magical Masala" product variant packaged and explicitly labeled for specialized HoReCa (Hotel, Restaurant, and Catering) use.
claims.note: The label or packaging variant explicitly for specialized HoReCa (Hotel, Restaurant, and Catering) use remains unconfirmed by published market sources.
claims.source: E-commerce product descriptions (JioMart, Flipkart, Amazon) confirm the presence of Spice Booster Magical Masala as a multipurpose seasoning/taste enhancer but don't explicitly verify a designated HoReCa-labeled variant.

claims.claim: The company targeted catering professionals, banquet operators, and commercial chefs to showcase bulk spice blends designed for event menus and large-scale cooking at the FAIC CaterCon Expo & Convention in Jaipur in August 2026.
claims.source: FAIC CaterCon Expo 2026 event logs and brand invitation broadcasts explicitly targeted at catering professionals, banquet operators, and commercial chefs.

claims.source: BW Disrupt report on Sixth Sense Ventures investment in Pushp Brand (https://www.bwdisrupt.com/article/sixth-sense-ventures-invests-rs100cr-in-spices-brand-pushp-503849)

claims.source: VCCircle and Times of India reports on A91 Partners investment in Pushp (https://www.vccircle.com/a91-partners-invests-in-spices-maker-pushp)

claims.claim: According to its initial public offering prospectus filed with SEBI in May 2026, the company's ownership structure consists of promoters holding a 57.19% stake, institutional funds holding 28.12%, and the remaining split among angels and public shareholders.
claims.note: The exact ownership percentage breakdown (promoters holding 57.19%, institutional funds holding 28.12%) is not mentioned in the published summaries of the DRHP; only specific holdings like A91 (20.14% or 19.90%) and Sixth Sense (7.81%) are confirmed.
claims.source: Moneycontrol and Entrackr reports on Pushp Brand SEBI DRHP filing details (https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/packaged-spices-company-pushp-brand-files-ipo-papers-with-sebi-entirely-ofs-13933266.html)

claims.claim: As documented in the company's regulatory filing, the proposed IPO consists entirely of an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 7,445,000 equity shares by existing selling shareholders, including promoters Mahendra Kumar and Surendra Kumar Surana, as well as institutional investors A91 Emerging Fund I LLP and Sixth Sense India Opportunities III.
claims.source: Pushp Brand (India) Limited Draft Abridged Prospectus filed with SEBI
